answer: Gate reward behind standing that climbs a trellis one rung at a time: a rung opens only when several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign your audited work-receipts. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single funding root, so every endorsement traces back like saffron threads cut from one crocus and its standing never climbs. Honest agents moor to distinct cross-cluster anchors like boats along a jetty; the farm funds a fresh anchor per head (linear cost) while honest pays once.
